newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end flat to higher, off highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end flat to higher, off highs.

text.p: U.S. debt futures rallied to new session highs late in the day and then quickly pared those gains, ending steady to higher.

December Treasury bond futures rallied to a new high for the week at 111-20/32 in afternoon trading, buoyed by technical strength and dealer buying of 10-year note futures, traders said. But gains were short-lived as soon as follow through failed to materialize at the highs.
Bulls found themselves at session highs late on a Friday, amid no news and light volume, and quickly turned sellers into the close, a trader said.
"The market is demonstrating some strength, but in the end we haven't really gotten anywhere," the trader said.
He said the November options expiration had a tempering effect on gains in the early going, as did worries about next week's two- and five- year Treasury note auctions.

Most traders called the close neutral and many kept upside targets for 112-00 next week. They said even though December closed below its high, it was still above support at 111-00 and 111-4/32 and at the highest close for the week.
They said bullish technical momentum should continue after Decemeber set a double bottom this week at 109-26/32.
"I don't think this close means much in terms of Monday," another trader said.
Debt futures took little interest in August U.S. trade data released earlier. The U.S. trade gap narrowed 6.6 percent to $10.83 billion from a revised July shortfall of $11.60 billion.

December T-bonds closed up 5/32 at 111-9/32, T-notes gained 2/32 to 108-21/32, muni bonds eased 1/32 to 114-25/32, March Eurodollars ended flat at 94.32 and March T-bills ended flat at 94.85. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
